name: Morrow native session control
transport: private parent-created anonymous pipes; child stdin=host frames, stdout=client frames, stderr=bounded diagnostics
fields: Challenge=1 Hello=2 Welcome=3 Query=4 State=5 Denied=6 Stop=7 Close=8
Challenge/Stop=0; Hello=1; subsequent client requests strictly previous+1; replies echo request
host issued nonzero, never a client identity claim
starts 1; host increments once on revocation
host monotonic deadline observation; client echoes initial Challenge value
SHA256 exact bytes of this file
host prelaunch digest; not proof against replacement race
Challenge initial maximum; replies remaining; client echoes initial maximum
1=read-only own session state; no other capability supported
handshake: host sends Challenge; client checks schema/platform outside wire, echoes exact Challenge fields except kind=Hello,sequence=1,code=0; host binds to its existing admission and child pipes then sends Welcome
client_requests: after Welcome copy initial Challenge; kind Query or Close, code0, strictly increasing sequence. No approved field. Other kinds fail closed. No pipelining: one request then one response. Stop may arrive at any time on this v2 channel; no legacy protocol mixing.
revocation: host control is outside client frame queue; trusted revoke acknowledges only once authority is invalidated. New requests thereafter denied. Previously fully written responses cannot be retracted. Partial pending response cancellation closes channel, never splices a Stop into partial frame.
limits: max frame256, one partial input and one pending output, fixed handshake/frame/closing deadlines, bounded total requests and stderr. Invalid frames never become host control. No data-plane operations or fallback.
